newsitem.headline: NOTICE OF SALE - Rolling Meadows, Ill.

text.p: City of Rolling Meadows City of Rolling Meadows
Cook County, Illinois Cook County, Illinois
General Obligation Tax Increment Taxable General
Separate sealed bids for the bonds will be received until

at the office of Kane, McKenna Capital, Inc., 150 North Wacker Drive, Suite 1600, Chicago, Illinois, for the above bonds dated November 1, 1996. The Series 1996A Bonds mature December 1, 1997-2001, inclusive. The Series 1996B Bonds mature December 1, 2000-2007, inclusive. The Series 1996A Bonds are not callable.

The Series 1996B Bonds are callable on December 1, 2005 and thereafter in the manner provided in the Official Notice of Sale. The City will designate the Series 1996A Bonds as ax-exempt obligations ''

pursuant to the small issuer exemption provided by Section 265(b)(3) of the Internal Revenue Code of 1986. The Bonds will be issued in book-entry form only, in the form of one certificate for the aggregate principal amount of the Bonds maturing in each year. The City will furnish the bonds with CUSIP numbers printed thereon and the approving legal opinion of Chapman and Cutler, Chicago, Illinois. All bids must be for all bonds at a price of not less than 99% plus accrued interest. Bid forms, together with the Official Statement and Official Notice of Sale, may be obtained from:
